# OREENZA — Performance-first design & development agency

## Who we are
OREENZA is an independent design & development agency building performance-first brands, websites, products, and motion for ambitious teams. We are remote-first and work with clients worldwide.

Founded: 2024

## Services
OREENZA offers six core services:
- [Brand Identity](/services/brand-strategy-identity): Naming, logo systems, visual guidelines, brand voice
- [Web Design & UX](/services/web-design--ux): UX/UI, design systems, Next.js builds, CMS setup (Keystatic)
- [Web Development](/services/web-development): Next.js, React, TypeScript, performance optimization
- [AI Automations](/services/ai-automations): Content calendars, captions, community engagement, analytics
- [AI-Powered SEO](/services/ai-powered-seo): AI keyword research, content optimization, technical SEO audits, rank tracking
- [AI Search Visibility](/services/ai-search-visibility): GBP Management, profile setup, weekly posts, review responses, local SEO

## Work
OREENZA has shipped projects across industries including SaaS, retail, food & beverage, finance, architecture, travel, healthcare, and beauty. Case studies available at /project/[slug].

## Projects
- [Sakura Sushi Bar](/project/sakura) — Modern sushi experience with reservation-first website
- [Velvet Bean](/project/velvet_bean) — Specialty coffee roaster brand & subscription platform
- [Pizza House](/project/pizza_house) — Neighbourhood pizzeria rebrand & direct-order website
- [Osetra](/project/oestra) — Modern Soho caviar house with reservation-first website
- [TasteIt](/project/tasteit) — Food discovery platform with explore & share loop

## Team
OREENZA is a small senior team of designers, engineers, and writers who ship for clients from cafés to SaaS companies.

## Technology
- Built with Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Keystatic CMS
- TypeScript throughout
- Performance-first: Lighthouse 95+ targets
- Deploys on Vercel
